notes.title: Patch notes 1.03
notes.content:
Bug list: 
1. 1 HP mode lvl 15 doors does not work - Fixed
2. 1 HP mode lvl 19 wrong coordinates after respawn and restart - Fixed
3. 1 HP mode lvl 16 wrong coordinates after respawn or restart - Fixed
4. Wrong localization in the info room - Fixed
5. Wrong camera size in 20 lvl at 1HP mode and hard mode - Fixed 
6. Hitting jackpot does not unlock skin - Fixed 
7. Game does not load saved language after restart - Fixed 
8. Bugged doors in Lvl 20 at 1HP mode and hard mode - Fixed

notes.title: After release bug fixing 1.02
notes.content:
Bug list: 
1. Rolling into wall while being on ladder freezes player - Fixed
2. Skins earned for passing worlds were unlocked all the time - Fixed
3. Dying/Killing on ladder coused player to freeze - Fixed
4. Doors does not work in 19 lvl at 1HP mode - Potential fix 
5.  Multiple bugs with wrong localization - Fixed 
6. Multiple bugs with restarting levels - Fixed
7. Multiple bugs with dying on level - Fixed
8. After leveling 1HP Mode player keep having 1 HP - Fixed
